text.content:
A cramped, defensible nook that's seen enough foot traffic to wear a path through the rubble. Half a dozen off-duty goblins are sacked out against the walls, sleeping in a heap for warmth, one snoring loud enough to be a hazard in its own right.

GM Notes

Breather: Not a fight unless the party makes it one - the sleepers are genuinely off-duty and will stay that way unless woken (a failed Stealth check while moving through, or anyone loud enough).

Subquest - Eavesdropping: One sleeper talks in their sleep, in complete, informative sentences, about "the funny-colored one" (Corvin) and how he "doesn't smell like a goblin anymore, but don't say that where he can hear it." Free foreshadowing for Room 28, if the party has the patience to listen to a goblin snore for a minute.
